pr_body:
Closes #70

## Summary

Updates the Wiki sync workflow and documentation to reflect the observed first-run behaviour: GitHub may not expose the `.wiki.git` backing repository until the Wiki is seeded once through the web UI.

## Changes

- Replaces the failed first-run git initialisation attempt with a clearer workflow error directing maintainers to seed a minimal Wiki Home page through the GitHub UI.
- Adds a first-run Wiki seeding section to `docs/wiki_sync_workflow.md`.
- Clarifies that a valid `WIKI_PUSH_TOKEN` can still see a repository-not-found error before the Wiki backing repository exists.

## Validation

- `git apply --check /tmp/issue70.diff` on the exact unified diff in a clean temporary git worktree.
- Documentation and workflow-shell change only; the Wiki sync workflow was not re-run for this clarification patch.
